I'll take a few minutes to gather my thoughts and energy before diving back into work.

thoughts.Alex: I'm feeling a bit drained from the past week's struggles, but knowing Sam is here to support me motivates me to tackle today's tasks. I need to focus on getting the Titan Corp Market Campaign moving and make the most of my energy levels. thoughts.Vikram: I'm feeling overwhelmed with the Titan Corp Market Campaign deadline looming, but I've been using it as an excuse to neglect my own well-being. I need to find a balance between meeting my responsibilities and taking care of myself. Today, I'll make sure to prioritize my own needs.
